name: CyBe RT (Robot Track)
summary: 3D concrete printer with an ABB robot arm that travels on a stationary floor track (from 5 m, extendable in 1 m steps), for printing large precast elements and prefab house parts in series.

germany.statusNote: EU maker (Netherlands) sells directly through its sales team and contact form, with a published 'price from' figure ex works; no German distributor found. CyBe says it distributes worldwide and the printers are modular for transport.

priceEur.note: 'Price from €240,000*' with '*Price ex works, based on standard dimensions'; tax basis not stated.

sellers.name: CyBe Construction B.V.
sellers.note: Oss, Netherlands; the contact form has the option 'I want to buy a printer'. Price is ex works, standard dimensions; transport and import taxes are paid by the buyer.

specs.label: Print range L × W × H (standard)
specs.quote: Length x Width x Height: 5 m x 2.5 m 4 m (standard)

specs.label: Track length
specs.quote: The CyBe RT’s track length can be extended in increments of 1 meter by attaching additional 1-meter plates.

specs.label: Print speed
specs.quote: At 500 millimeters per second, CyBe printers have the fastest print speed in the market.

specs.label: Robot
specs.value: ABB robot arm on a linear track
specs.quote: Our CyBe RT (Robot Track) is a 3D printer with an ABB robotic arm that moves across a stationary track setup.

specs.label: Operating crew
specs.conditions: one at the control unit, one at the mortar mixer
specs.quote: The printer is operated by just two persons

specs.label: Elements can be lifted after
specs.quote: Elements can be hoisted after 24 hours and transported to the project site for installation.

specs.label: Training included
specs.quote: CyBe supplies the full package: hardware, software, materials, service, designs, and 10-day training at any location.

notes: The arm rides on a fixed floor track; concrete parts are printed beside the track.
Needs a mortar mixing and pumping unit; CyBe sells its own CyBe Mortar.
Built for factory (precast) use rather than for moving around a site.

images.alt: CyBe RT 3D concrete printer, robot arm on a floor track

evidence.task: Printed 14 different building facade elements in one serial print job
